Ukwakha ama-disaccharide, amaliphidi kanye nama-peptide kususelwa ezakhiweni ezithile.
Ukudweba izakhiwo zokwamakhemikhali okuphilayo ezimbandakanyekayo ezinhlelweni zokuphefumula kanye neze-
Ukuchaza izinhlelo zokumfoma kwesisi, ze-photosynthesis, kanye nezokuphefumula kanye nezimo ezizithintayo.
Ukuchaza ukwenzeka okuhambisana nesigqa kanye nemithelela yako ekukhuleni kwezitshalo.

Ukwenza izilinge, ukuhlaziya imiphumela kanye nokubhala imibiko emva kwalokho ezintweni eziphathelene nokumfoma kwesisi, ukwakhiwa kwesitashi, ukuphefumula kanye ne-Mendelian
Ngaphezu kwalokhu, abafundi kumele bakwazi ukukhombisa amakhono nolwazi olubalulekile emikhakheni eyahlukene yezifundo zabo:
